entries.title: "Er ligt een roofstaat", the ship of the islands
entries.hook: A sculpted ship for the islands' yards, cut with Multatuli's line about a robber state.

entries.title: The floating gardens of Robert Jasper Grootveld, Wittenburgervaart
entries.hook: Three planted rafts in the provo's knotting technique, banned by the city in 2021, then given to the neighbourhood.

entries.title: Kattenburger Triomfboog
entries.hook: Twenty-five old Kattenburgers wrote their own history; their handwriting is fired onto the tiles of an arch.

entries.title: Mbulu Ngulu on the advertising column, Czaar Peterstraat
entries.hook: Since 1991 a West African reliquary guardian with purple rods sits on top of an advertising column.

entries.title: Jakoba Mulder's lamp, Mulderplein
entries.hook: A tilted disc, a leaf-cut lamp and nine chairs for one of the first women city planners.

entries.title: Kattenburg's fake old facades and the rent strike
entries.hook: The cleared island got a reconstructed gabled row; its tenants then held back rent for fifteen years and won.

entries.title: Het Funen, sixteen blocks by sixteen architects, and Lester's shards
entries.hook: A car-free park of sixteen blocks on five-sided tiles, with giant shards mapping the old bastion.

entries.title: The navy's firing range, now a roof garden facing NEMO
entries.hook: A windowless shooting range reopened in 2023 with a grandstand stair to a roof garden over the Oosterdok.

entries.title: Plukbos, the food forest behind the Wittenburg blocks
entries.hook: After three shootings a resident turned a dog field into a food forest open day and night.

entries.title: Shaffy's Tuin and the Shaffyboom
entries.hook: A garden named after Ramses Shaffy, and a maple that swallowed the railway fence, named for his 75th birthday.

entries.title: Hoogte Kadijk, the sea dike that still works
entries.reason: sluice figures need a Waternet source
entries.hook: In 2023 the city shut its sluices and the old dike was the water barrier again; stones and a lost yard.

entries.title: Tkramrepus, the supermarket in reverse
entries.hook: "Supermarkt" backwards: you bring groceries instead of taking them; food-bank shoppers take free.

entries.title: Touwbaanpark, the 400-year fence and Waaigat 2
entries.hook: A park on the VOC ropewalk line, a 300 m fence telling 400 years, and a silent garden with viewing windows.

entries.title: The animal bridges of 1018: tug of war on the Kippebrug, roses on the hippo bridge
entries.reason: Still there? (tug of war unconfirmed after 2019)
entries.hook: The islands fight a yearly tug of war on a Kramer footbridge; the hippo bridge is their swimming spot.

entries.title: Simon Erb's sgraffito school front, Tweede Leeghwaterstraat 7
entries.hook: A 1960 sgraffito on the De Ruiterschool, rated "Top" by the city's wall-art register.

entries.title: The floating ball in the Oostenburgerpark
entries.hook: A granite ball floats on a film of water so a child can spin it.

entries.title: Dijksgracht-Oost, the railway bank where a polecat stopped the bike path
entries.hook: Residents have defended a scrubby railway bank for a decade, with bats and a polecat on their side.

entries.title: Aat Veldhoen's house with the palette, Wittenburgergracht
entries.hook: The painter arrested for "indecent" prints of lovers lived behind a big painter's palette.

entries.title: Hondenliefhebbersbankje, the dog lovers' bench
entries.reason: Okay; Location (pin may be in Oost)
entries.hook: A home-made bench with the names of the dogs that come here carved in old café chair backs.

entries.title: Nieuwe Oostenburgerstraat, "het schattigste straatje"
entries.hook: Workers' houses of 1871 with postage-stamp gardens and benches under the kitchen windows.

entries.title: Tonia Stieltjesplein, Oostenburg
entries.hook: Residents named their new square after a Black trade-union woman of the 1920s.

entries.title: The railway tunnel under the Dijksgracht, a graffiti free zone in the making
entries.hook: A tunnel of rough sleepers and bike wrecks is to become a legal graffiti hall of fame.

entries.title: The roof garden of the Laagte Kadijk
entries.reason: Okay; pin approximate; or a Look for in Sibbelwoningen
entries.hook: A public garden on a garage roof, open day and night, a short cut to the Sibbelpark.

entries.title: Windroosplein: the garden instead of a basketball court, and De Waarheid's stone
entries.hook: Residents swapped a planned court for a garden of 150 plants; the underground paper's memorial stands on the square.
